scope: g1-ci regression revalidation for the Gate 3 dependency change
cause: Editing the scoped gates_v2.py invalidated the prior g1-ci fingerprint.
decision: Revalidate g1-ci for the changed ledger script. Gate 3 technical verification may begin after Gate 1 completes. Gate 2 approval is still required for real privilege assignments and deployment; Gates 4–8 retain their cumulative prerequisites. Keep Twill disabled for Gate 3.
observed_result: Local, revision-pinned test called documents() with mocked task_status(): stale g1-ci kept Gate 3 BLOCKED; completed Gate 1 let Gate 3 become IN_PROGRESS while Gate 2 was AWAITING_APPROVAL; simulated Gate 3 completion left Gates 4–8 BLOCKED while Gate 2 was pending. All three cases passed.
